_provenance: Transcribed from live run screenshots (Contract B, 30s). Quotes shown in the live JSON match the contract paragraphs verbatim.

requirements.title: Commercial General Liability limits (Exhibit D)
requirements.plain: Vendor must carry CGL insurance with at least $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 general aggregate. These limits likely govern because Section 1.3 requires compliance with the more stringent of conflicting Agreement and Exhibit requirements, and they exceed the $1M/$2M in Section 12.2(a). Confidence is medium because the two provisions conflict and D.2 applies to 'trade contractors' rather than naming Subcontractor directly.
requirements.quote: All trade contractors shall carry commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 general aggregate.

requirements.title: Commercial General Liability limits (Section 12)
requirements.plain: Section 12.2(a) requires Vendor to carry CGL with at least $1,000,000 each occurrence and $2,000,000 general aggregate. The higher Exhibit D.2 limits likely supersede this under the more-stringent-requirement rule in Section 1.3. Confidence is medium because of that conflict.
requirements.quote: Commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 each occurrence and $2,000,000 general aggregate.

requirements.title: Additional insured status on CGL
requirements.plain: Vendor must name Contractor, Owner, and their respective officers and employees as additional insureds on its CGL policy for liability arising out of Vendor's work. Confidence is medium because the contract does not say whether this covers ongoing operations, completed operations, or both, so no scope is listed.
requirements.quote: Contractor, Owner, and their respective officers and employees shall be included as additional insureds under Subcontractor’s commercial general liability policy with respect to liability arising out of Subcontractor’s work.

requirements.title: Primary and non-contributory coverage
requirements.plain: Vendor's insurance must be primary and non-contributory with respect to any insurance maintained by Contractor or Owner.
requirements.quote: Subcontractor’s insurance shall be primary and non-contributory with respect to any insurance maintained by Contractor or Owner.

requirements.title: Waiver of subrogation on CGL, auto, and workers' compensation
requirements.plain: Vendor must waive recovery rights against Contractor and Owner and obtain waiver of subrogation endorsements in their favor on its CGL, business auto, and workers' compensation policies.
requirements.quote: Subcontractor waives all rights of recovery against Contractor and Owner to the extent of any loss covered by its commercial general liability, business automobile, and workers’ compensation insurance, and shall obtain endorsements from its insurers waiving subrogation in favor of Contractor and Owner on each of those policies.

external_references.quote: Subcontractor shall also comply with all insurance and enrollment requirements of the Owner Controlled Insurance Program Manual issued by Owner, which is incorporated into this Agreement by reference.

out_of_scope.title: Insurers must be authorized in the Project state; coverage required before starting work
out_of_scope.quote: Before starting work, Subcontractor shall obtain and thereafter maintain the following insurance with insurers authorized to do business in the state where the Project is located.

out_of_scope.title: Business automobile liability, $1,000,000 combined single limit
out_of_scope.quote: Business automobile liability insurance with a combined single limit of not less than $1,000,000 per accident.

out_of_scope.title: Workers' compensation (statutory) and employer's liability, $1,000,000 each accident
out_of_scope.quote: Workers’ compensation insurance as required by law and employer’s liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 each accident.

out_of_scope.title: Contractor's pollution liability, $2,000,000 per occurrence
out_of_scope.quote: Contractor’s pollution liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence, covering pollution conditions arising from Subcontractor’s work.

out_of_scope.title: Certificates of insurance and endorsement copies before starting work
out_of_scope.quote: Subcontractor shall furnish certificates of insurance and copies of the required endorsements to Contractor before starting work.

out_of_scope.title: 30 days' notice of cancellation, non-renewal, or material reduction
out_of_scope.quote: Subcontractor shall give Contractor at least thirty (30) days’ prior written notice of cancellation, non-renewal, or material reduction of any required coverage.

out_of_scope.title: Comply with OCIP Manual insurance and enrollment requirements
out_of_scope.quote: Subcontractor shall also comply with all insurance and enrollment requirements of the Owner Controlled Insurance Program Manual issued by Owner, which is incorporated into this Agreement by reference.

out_of_scope.title: Inland marine / equipment floater (recommended, not required)
out_of_scope.quote: Contractor recommends, but does not require, that Subcontractor carry an inland marine or equipment floater policy covering its tools and equipment while at the Project site.
